observations.behavior: Adds GitHub PR URL parsing and repository extraction, and the groupActivityRows implementation, and its tests, and the UI changes to use it.
observations.posthog_connection: Collapses repeated activity rows into a single row, reducing noise and preserving the newest timestamp. This could help PostHog users see a cleaner activity timeline, especially when many pushes or PRs occur in a short period.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single hunk. No other chunks or PRs are supplied, so no relationship between unrelated PRs can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a GroupedEventRow component that groups multiple activity events of the same kind into a single timeline row, and a PrGroupLink helper that safely renders GitHub URLs. P1.F7.H2 adds the PrGroupLink implementation and the GroupedEventRow body, including the commits_pushed and pr_created/pr_merged branches.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support the Desktop app's activity feed by grouping multiple push or PR events into one row, potentially reducing DOM size and improving readability. The PrGroupLink implementation checks the URL origin before allowing a GitHub link, which could prevent XSS if a malicious payload supplies a GitHub-looking URL. No score assigned.
